native_route_validation.sample_arithmetic: Double interpolation and grid-cell lookup from original Float waypoint coordinates

coverage_limitations.sampling: Every component of at least 1 m² was sampled in both directions to/from Information. Smaller raster fragments are included in the complete cell counts. The largest network was sampled once per 8 m plan tile.

food_court_wider_clearance.interpretation: The 0.45m obstacle margin meets the boundary of measured floor. A 0.30m route exists, but this does not measure physical aisle width or prove physical inaccessibility; extra unmeasured floor may permit a wider route.
food_court_wider_clearance.obstacle_source: Native 7714 RoomPlan detected chair bounding boxes, separate from the visual model furnishing layout. Retain detection uncertainty; this check does not establish physical inaccessibility.

atrium_pocket.interpretation: A measured floor pocket beyond the native chair cluster is disconnected at both clearances. Missing measured coverage and obstacle inflation prevent establishing a route; this is not a claim of physical inaccessibility.

other_limits: Auditorium interior rake and stage transitions remain visual only. The named Auditorium destination uses the measured rear foyer.
Arbitrary points must lie on clear measured coverage. Walls, voids, unmeasured floor and sloped transition interiors are not flat-floor targets.

Court Salon doors retain center posts and uncertainty-adjusted bay widths. One measured bay per set reaches the existing 0.81 m doorway threshold, but no bay is established to be at least 0.90 m wide.
All level connections belong to displayed Floor 1. Main-to-raised-L routes use stairs or the elevator. There is no ramp between these two levels.
